data.one_liner: Create custom dropdowns with styling, animations, and flexible data sources in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: The package enables you to easily implement dropdown menus with custom styling, custom animations, and data sources. It provides a RawFlexDropDown widget that utilizes OverlayPortal for flexible positioning and menu control.
use_when: You need to build a custom dropdown widget with precise positioning and custom button or menu layouts.
You want to manage dropdown visibility with an OverlayPortalController.
avoid_when: You are looking for a fully styled Material Design dropdown out of the box without building custom widgets.
You need a simple standard form dropdown field and don't need custom styling or animations.
strengths: Supports custom styling and animations for dropdown menus.
Precise positioning and dismissal on tap outside.
Uses OverlayPortal for smooth rendering over other widgets.
weaknesses: Requires writing custom button and menu builders rather than providing a plug-and-play standard dropdown field.
Not documented with extensive pre-built UI themes.
